settings_description: Manage your account, app preferences, and committee settings.
settings_theme_description: Choose a light or dark theme.
settings_language_description: Change the interface language. Changes take effect immediately.
settings_analytics_description: Send anonymous launch events containing the app version, platform (Web or operating system), and a random installation ID. Disabling takes effect on the next launch.
settings_shortcuts_description: Shortcuts are read-only in this version. Customization will be available in a future version.
settings_import_battles_description: Import battles from a JSON file. Duplicate IDs are skipped automatically.
settings_import_empty: No battles imported; {skipped} entries already exist or are invalid.
settings_invalid_json: Could not parse JSON. Check the file format.
settings_clear_battles_description: Permanently delete all local battles. This cannot be undone.
settings_clear_battles_confirm: This cannot be undone. All battles will be permanently deleted.
settings_committee_description: Configure voting rules, display options, and local snapshots for the current committee.
settings_voting_description: Approval threshold for substantive votes, calculated from present seats with voting rights.
settings_voting_enter_committee: Open a committee to change its voting rules.
settings_default_icons_description: Unit icon style used for new battles.
settings_display_position_description: Adjust the horizontal and vertical offset (px) of the main Display content. You can also use Alt + arrow keys in the Display window.
settings_snapshots_description: Snapshots are saved automatically when phases change. The latest 20 per committee are retained, up to 100 on this device. Only local proceedings are restored; timers remain paused.
settings_snapshot_save_description: Save the current committee's speaker list, caucus, and voting progress locally.
settings_snapshot_save_failed: Snapshot not saved. Check local storage and try again.
settings_snapshot_restore_description: Select a snapshot to preview. Restoring replaces local proceedings and automatically backs up the current records.
settings_snapshot_confirm_description: Restoring replaces the current committee's local proceedings and pauses timers. The current records will be backed up first.
settings_snapshot_enter_committee: Open a committee to manage its local snapshots.
settings_account_description: Manage your profile, account security, and sign-in status here.
settings_cloud_sync_description: Enabled by default. Local conferences sync every 24 hours after sign-in, or when you select Sync now. Disabling keeps saving locally.
settings_cloud_sync_signed_out: Sign in to sync automatically. Conferences are currently saved locally.
settings_sync_conflict: “{name}” has conflicting saves. Exit the conference, then choose which version to keep.
settings_web_account_description: Use the cloud platform to manage your account on the web.
settings_sign_in_description: Use the same email and password as the cloud platform.
settings_code_sent: Verification code sent to your registered email. Valid for 5 minutes.
settings_code_required: Enter the 6-digit code from your email
settings_password_reset_success: Password reset. Sign in again with your new password.
settings_avatar_crop_description: Drag and zoom the image to crop a round avatar.
settings_avatar_hint: Select the avatar to replace it. Cropped images are compressed automatically · Maximum 512 KB
settings_profile_description: Manage your display name and account details.
settings_username_hint: Displayed as your identity. Up to 200 characters.
settings_email_readonly: Registered email. Changes are currently unavailable.
settings_organization_hint: The Model UN organization associated with your account.
settings_profile_save_hint: Your avatar and username will update after saving.
settings_security_description: Reset your password using a code sent to your registered email.
settings_code_destination: A code will be sent to {email}. Valid for 5 minutes.
settings_password_reset_hint: After resetting, sign in again on every device with the new password.
settings_sign_out_description: Signing out also signs out the embedded cloud platform on this device.
settings_update_latest: You are using the latest version.
settings_update_available: Version v{version} is available. Select Download update to install it.
settings_update_ready: Update ready. Restart the app to complete installation.
settings_update_error: An error occurred while checking for updates.
settings_update_description: Check whether a new version is available.
settings_contact_description: Join our community to discuss or report issues.
settings_contact_platform: Choose a community platform for discussion or feedback.
settings_license_description: This project is open source under GPL-3.0.
settings_repository_description: View source code or open an issue.
settings_mod_description: Manage installed extensions and import mod packages.
settings_mod_install_hint: Use the Install tab to import from the registry or a local file.
settings_mod_drop: Drop a .vmod file here or select a file
settings_mod_offline: Local imports work offline. No network required.
settings_registry_description: Get the plugin list from the official VetoExpress registry
settings_event_natural_description: Earthquakes, floods, and typhoons affect the operational area, mobility, and logistics
settings_event_refugee_description: Large refugee movements block transport routes and create humanitarian pressure
settings_event_electronic_description: GPS spoofing, communications jamming, and radar suppression reduce blue-force situational awareness
settings_event_conflict_description: Unexpected third-party clashes disrupt the battlefield flanks
settings_event_supply_description: Attacks on key supply routes cause shortages at the front
settings_event_uprising_description: Civilian unrest and occupation of infrastructure threaten rear-area stability
settings_battle_name_hint: Changes are saved automatically on blur.
settings_battle_start_hint: Starting point of the battle timeline.
settings_custom_speed_hint: Saved as an option in the control bar. Does not take effect immediately.
settings_event_configuration_hint: Configure random events and their trigger probabilities.
settings_export_battle_hint: Export the current battle as a JSON file.
settings_clear_log_hint: Clear recorded actions without affecting units or factions.
settings_clear_log_confirm: This cannot be undone. Clear all action records?
settings_delete_battle_hint: Permanently delete this battle. Its data cannot be recovered.
settings_delete_battle_confirm: This cannot be undone. Battle data will be permanently deleted.
settings_delete_battle_named: Permanently delete battle “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
settings_remove_conference_named: Remove conference “{name}” and its saved seat information from this device? The cloud conference will remain available.
settings_delete_conference_named: Permanently delete conference “{name}”? This cannot be undone.
settings_select_mode: Select a mode on the left
settings_select_mode_description: Choose a simulation mode to view and manage battles
settings_create_battle_hint: Create a battle to start a simulation
settings_campaign_name_hint: Choose a campaign and name your battle to begin.
settings_choose_campaign_hint: Select a preset campaign on the left to view its details
settings_mode_description: Choose a simulation mode. Campaign mode loads preset factions, maps, and events automatically.
settings_free_description: Configure every parameter and build a simulation from scratch.
settings_campaign_description: Choose a preset campaign, load its factions, maps, and events, then name your battle to begin.
settings_free_mode_description: Combine factions, mods, and time settings to customize your simulation.
settings_command_search: Search for a command to run
